mapper.select: select dprfd.id, q.dates, q.pkg, q.register_dates, q.register_day, q.retention_user_num from (select lr.dates, lr.pkg, lr.register_dates, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, lr.register_dates, lr.dates) register_day, count(DISTINCT lr.user_id) retention_user_num from dwd_user_login_record lr where lr.dates = #{dates} group by lr.dates, lr.pkg, lr.register_dates) q LEFT JOIN dws_pkg_retention_full_daily dprfd ON (dprfd.dates = q.dates and dprfd.pkg = q.pkg and dprfd.register_dates = q.register_dates)
